mapper.select: SELECT id, chapter_id as chapterId, title, video_url as videoUrl, duration, sort_order as sortOrder, is_free as isFree, create_time as createTime FROM lesson WHERE chapter_id = #{chapterId} ORDER BY sort_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lesson (chapter_id, title, video_url, duration, sort_order, is_free) VALUES (#{chapterId}, #{title}, #{videoUrl}, #{duration}, #{sortOrder}, #{isFree})
mapper.update: UPDATE lesson SET title = #{title}, video_url = #{videoUrl}, duration = #{duration}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, is_free = #{isFree} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lesson l JOIN chapter c ON l.chapter_id = c.id WHERE c.course_id = #{courseId}
